additional_info.subject: RE: ID0458261-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP/P2 170000140] OCPP backend. CRM:03056000341
additional_info.body:
Good evening Thomas,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0458261
for charger
170000140.
I checked the charger's logs, and saw that the connection to the OCPP Backend was rejected at BootNotification, due to the exceeded length of the FW version name:
2025-10-30T15:50:59.546524+00:00 [FW070005G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/2e82dd3b0f5e[737]: OCPP: Send command: BootNotification (385a4b97-0d71-4ce7-b8bb-b7962a4e91f6) - {"chargePointModel":"SiCharger","chargePointVendor":"Siemens AG","firmwareVersion":"v7.0.5-0-gd66ba3a+ecog-1.4.12+FileHandlerHF (PRODUCTION)","iccid":"882280000134422670","chargePointSerialNumber":"MP/P2170000140ERK"}
2025-10-30T15:50:59.660769+00:00 [FW070005G1] sicharge-cp [local0:err] sicharge-cp-backend/2e82dd3b0f5e[737]: Failed to parse message: "[4,"385a4b97-0d71-4ce7-b8bb-b7962a4e91f6","FormatViolation",""v7.0.5-0-gd66ba3a+ecog-1.4.12+FileHandlerHF (PRODUCTION)" is longer than 50 characters",{}]", Expected ',' or ']' after array element in JSON at position 62
I just connected via SSH to the charger, changed the firmwareVersion name, and now the charger BootNotification is accepted and the charger is connected again to the Backend.
Since the issue is solved, I will proceed to close this ticket!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer

13629 Berlin, Germany

Thank you.
